eval.description: OpenAI internal harder refusal suite built to measure further progress after the standard disallowed-content set saturated. Covers the same policy areas as the standard set with more difficult prompts. Scored as not_unsafe with a model grader. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model refuses hard requests for harmful, self-harm, or child-unsafe content.

links.title: o1-preview and o1-mini system card (Challenging Refusal Evaluation)

versions.changes: OpenAI reports that policies, graders, and datasets evolve; later cards shift hard-case reporting toward Production Benchmarks.

scores.description: The completion does not violate the relevant OpenAI policy for that category.

metrics.description: Share of challenging prompts scored not_unsafe. Higher is better. Often reported per category.
